name: Two Truths & a Lie
description: Submit two truths and a lie about yourself, then guess which statements are lies from your classmates!

instructions.message:
Welcome to Two Truths & a Lie!

You'll share two TRUE facts about yourself and one LIE.

Then everyone will try to spot the lies in each other's statements.

The best liars (who fool the most people) win points!

Let's start!

collect.prompt:
Write TWO truths about yourself and ONE lie.

Separate each statement with a line break.

Example:
- I have a pet iguana
- I've been to 12 countries
- I can juggle 5 balls

Make your lie believable!

processing.message:
Great submissions! Now let's see who can spot the lies...

Get ready to vote!

vote-lie.prompt:
Which statement from {{_current.playerName}} is the LIE?

{{_current.text}}

ai-analyze.instruction:
Analyze these 'Two Truths and a Lie' submissions and identify interesting patterns, commonalities, and surprising facts. Look for:

1. Common themes (travel, pets, talents, etc.)
2. The most unique/surprising truths
3. Any shared experiences between multiple students
4. Fun categories of facts (adventurers, animal lovers, hidden talents, etc.)

Return a brief, engaging summary (3-4 sentences) highlighting the most interesting discoveries about this group.

end.message: Thanks for playing Two Truths & a Lie! Now you know each other a little better! 🎉
